parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id', COALESCE(o.airtable_id, o.nocopk::text), 'fields', json_build_object(
  'name', o.name,
  'cash_receipt', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('receipt_id',r.receipt_id,'erp_pending',r.erp_references IS NULL) FROM public.mp_commerce_cash_receipts r WHERE r.provider=coalesce(nullif(o.provider,''),'ecwid') AND r.site_key=coalesce(nullif(o.site_key,''),'dank_mushrooms') AND r.external_order_id=coalesce(nullif(o.external_order_id,''),o.ecwid_order_id)),
  'fulfillment_progress', public.mp_fulfillment_progress(o.nocopk),
  'provider', o.provider,
  'site_key', o.site_key,
  'external_order_id', o.external_order_id,
  'external_skus', o.external_skus,
  'ecwid_order_id', o.ecwid_order_id,
  'order_number', o.order_number,
  'order_code', o.order_code,
  'status', o.status,
  'order_date', o.order_date,
  'customer_name', o.customer_name,
  'customer_email', o.customer_email,
  'items_json', o.items_json,
  'ecwid_skus', o.ecwid_skus,
  'payment_status', o.payment_status,
  'payment_method', o.payment_method,
  'subtotal', o.subtotal,
  'tax_total', o.tax_total,
  'order_total', o.order_total,
  'currency', o.currency,
  'payment_processor', o.payment_processor,
  'processor_payment_id', o.processor_payment_id,
  'processor_payment_status', o.processor_payment_status,
  'processor_payment_amount', o.processor_payment_amount,
  'processor_payment_time', o.processor_payment_time,
  'processor_match_confidence', o.processor_match_confidence,
  'payment_reconciliation_status', o.payment_reconciliation_status,
  'clover_reconciliation_status', o.clover_reconciliation_status,
  'clover_payment_id', o.clover_payment_id,
  'clover_payment_amount', o.clover_payment_amount,
  'clover_payment_time', o.clover_payment_time,
  'clover_match_confidence', o.clover_match_confidence,
  'reconciled_at', o.reconciled_at,
  'reconciliation_notes', o.reconciliation_notes,
  'ecwid_event_type', o.ecwid_event_type,
  'ecwid_event_id', o.ecwid_event_id,
  'last_webhook_at', o.last_webhook_at,
  'products', COALESCE(lp.product_record_ids, ARRAY[]::text[]),
  'products_report', COALESCE(lp.product_names, ''),
  'product_ids_report', COALESCE(lp.product_ids, '')
)) ORDER BY o.order_date DESC), '[]'::json) AS records
FROM public.ecommerce_orders o
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    array_agg(COALESCE(p.airtable_id, p.nocopk::text) ORDER BY p.product_id) AS product_record_ids,
    string_agg(COALESCE(p.name_mat, p.product_id, p.nocopk::text), ', ' ORDER BY p.product_id) AS product_names,
    string_agg(COALESCE(p.product_id, p.nocopk::text), ', ' ORDER BY p.product_id) AS product_ids
  FROM public._m2m_products_ecommerce_orders_ecommerce_orders m
  JOIN public.products p ON p.nocopk = m.products_id
  WHERE m.ecommerce_orders_id = o.nocopk
) lp ON true;

parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body||$json; const id=String(body.airtable_record_id||'').trim(); if(!id) throw new Error('Missing airtable_record_id'); return [{json:{airtable_record_id:id, timezone:String(body.timezone||'America/Denver')}}];

  'ecwid_event_type', o.ecwid_event_type,
  'ecwid_event_id', o.ecwid_event_id,
  'last_webhook_at', o.last_webhook_at,
  'products', COALESCE(lp.product_record_ids, ARRAY[]::text[]),
  'products_report', COALESCE(lp.product_names, ''),
  'product_ids_report', COALESCE(lp.product_ids, '')
) AS fields
FROM public.ecommerce_orders o
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    array_agg(COALESCE(p.airtable_id, p.nocopk::text) ORDER BY p.product_id) AS product_record_ids,
    string_agg(COALESCE(p.name_mat, p.product_id, p.nocopk::text), ', ' ORDER BY p.product_id) AS product_names,
    string_agg(COALESCE(p.product_id, p.nocopk::text), ', ' ORDER BY p.product_id) AS product_ids

  JOIN public.products p ON p.nocopk = m.products_id
  WHERE m.ecommerce_orders_id = o.nocopk
) lp ON true
WHERE COALESCE(o.airtable_id, o.nocopk::text) = '${String($json.airtable_record_id || $json.airtable_order_record_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}'
   OR o.nocopk::text = '${String($json.airtable_record_id || $json.airtable_order_record_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}'
LIMIT 1;` }}

{{ `WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE public.ecommerce_orders
  SET payment_processor = NULLIF('${String($json.fields?.payment_processor ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}',''),
      payment_reconciliation_status = NULLIF('${String($json.fields?.payment_reconciliation_status ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}',''),
      processor_payment_id = NULLIF('${String($json.fields?.processor_payment_id ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}',''),
      processor_payment_status = NULLIF('${String($json.fields?.processor_payment_status ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}',''),
      processor_payment_amount = NULLIF('${String($json.fields?.processor_payment_amount ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}','')::numeric,
      processor_payment_time = NULLIF('${String($json.fields?.processor_payment_time ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}','')::timestamp,
      processor_match_confidence = NULLIF('${String($json.fields?.processor_match_confidence ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}','')::numeric,

      reconciled_at = NULLIF('${String($json.fields?.reconciled_at ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}','')::timestamp,
      reconciliation_notes = NULLIF('${String($json.fields?.reconciliation_notes ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''")}',''),
      nc_updated_at = now()
  WHERE COALESCE(airtable_id, nocopk::text) = '${String($json.airtable_order_record_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}'
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT COALESCE(upd.airtable_id, upd.nocopk::text) AS id,
       json_build_object(
         'payment_processor', upd.payment_processor,
         'payment_reconciliation_status', upd.payment_reconciliation_status,
         'processor_payment_id', upd.processor_payment_id,
         'processor_payment_status', upd.processor_payment_status,

         'processor_payment_time', upd.processor_payment_time,
         'processor_match_confidence', upd.processor_match_confidence,

         'clover_payment_amount', upd.clover_payment_amount,
         'clover_payment_time', upd.clover_payment_time,
         'clover_match_confidence', upd.clover_match_confidence,
         'reconciled_at', upd.reconciled_at,
         'reconciliation_notes', upd.reconciliation_notes
       ) AS fields
FROM upd;` }}
